Chapter 211. Orgal's Negotiation (1)
The masterpiece of the contaminated Ketam was restored to its original form. And Ketam, as promised, created a spring picture book for Murakan and sent it to the Garden of the Sword.
"Ah, what is this... Hmm, it's invaluable in the sense that it's a spring picture book painted by God himself, but it's not at all spicy. Damn, they're all naked but it makes me feel devout."
"Is that so."
"Well, I do like the portraits of those guys that you sent as a reward as requested by the kid. It's well drawn."
Dranax, Vyollo, Frey, Silderay, Diana, Sarah, Padler, Bale.

Jin asked Ketam for portraits of the ten knights as a reward for restoring the painting. Ketam was able to vividly recall their faces as soon as Jin and Murakan exited the painting. This incident has once again weakened Jifl's historical manipulation.

Jin hung all the portraits, except for Padler, in the inner chamber of the Sword Garden. He deliberately chose a place that was noticeable, not the corridor used for the rider ceremony or the mausoleum that people don't usually visit.
Because he thought all the members of the family should remember their history now.

There was no reason to hide it like he did when he was a prospective rider or a rider. He had no reason to care about Jifl's opinion after breaking the oath. As soon as he returned, Jin shared with the members of the family everything he had experienced in Ketam's painting.
"Temar, I intentionally didn't commission a portrait of the first family head. On the day we end the war and recover all the lost history of the family, I will hang his portrait in the Sword Garden."
So far, Jin has found seven of Temar's tombs.
The history of a thousand years ago, which was only cloudy and distant, has now been confirmed for its major timeline, and there probably aren't many tombs left.
"I assume the tomb will be related to the last ten knights, Lady Lucia, who has never appeared in any of the tombs we've been through so far."
- The surviving ones are... you... and who else?
- It's hard to confirm the life and death. Lucia is the most likely.
The conversation between Murakan and Lokia in the painting.
Considering the circumstances, Lucia must have been the ten knights who survived the longest after the war a thousand years ago, along with Lokia.

[I also think so, small head. Lucia... Lucira. Aside from the fact that she was a woman, I can't think of anything else. When I had forgotten about my other colleagues before, even though I couldn't remember, I somehow missed them and my heart hurt. But I can't think of anything about her.]
“I feel the same, Lueth. Lucira, having survived until the end, must have posed the greatest threat to Zipfel. Hence, she probably went through particularly strong historical manipulations."
"After all, Zipfel lost Elona in the final battle with Temar. If Lucira was as strong as Sarah, or possessed special abilities, it would be entirely plausible."
There were no clues about the eighth tomb or Lucira at the moment.

"To find the next tomb or traces of the Knight of Ten, Lucira, we need to recover the entire memory of the Housekeeper through Valeria. According to the history in the painting, the Housekeeper made Temar's tomb with Solderet at that time."
The information that Barisada was the key to somewhere depended on Lueth's memory. It was slightly discomforting to say it was just false information due to pollution.
"Yes. Or finding Lokia's whereabouts could also be an option."
The image that Lokia showed at the seventh tomb was somewhat ambiguous to call her a traitor like Padler said. However, there were aspects that coincided with Lokia's current moves.
"Diana, do you think this world is fair?"
"What?"

"That's right. We are the ones pursuing justice and liberation in this world. Yet, why is it that we are more tormented than Zipfel, who manipulates history and practices evil to become the ruler of the world? Is this fair?
"What are you saying? Are you abandoning the family...?"
"My ideal is no longer in this family. Listen, Kin, we lost a lot fighting for Runcandel. Still, would you tell us to fight more? By what right do you..."
Conversations that Lokia had with Diana and Kin in the painting.

From Jin's perspective, Lokia seemed to be pursuing a 'fair' world. That coincided with what the followers of the Sun God's resurrection wanted. The followers of the Sun God believe that the world will be perfected when the Sun God returns.

"By the way, the painting was polluted by Lokia or the Witch... I don't understand why. Whatever the reason for polluting the painting, you eventually erased the fake history created by the pollution and faced the truth, so their objective would have failed."

"The reason? Isn't it obvious, Lueth? The person who polluted the painting was aiming at me. Their goal was probably to collapse my mind and make me run rampant through fake history. It's probably because I've regained my strength and returned, which is burdensome."
"Oh, you can make a reasonable argument, Murakan."
"And if I am burdensome, it's likely Lokia, not the witch. Although it's true that I'm great, the witch isn't scared of anything."
Afterwards, for a while, Murakan and Lueth continued their conversation, engrossed in memories of their old colleagues.
Murakan shed many tears inside the painting, enough to never have to cry again, and that sadness still lingered in his heart.
But he knew he had to stand up and move forward for them. Jin and his new colleagues had no intention of letting him go.
Jin stepped back from his position and looked over the reports.
The war between the Zephyr and the Enemy Tribe had not changed much. It was only natural, considering he had spent just about three days in the painting.
'Even with Elona involved, the overall situation is still at a standstill. If Elona hadn't been there, the Enemy Tribe would have set the mood from the beginning.'
There were no reports that the Zephyr had located the Enemy Tribe's base yet.

'They must know that their base is somewhere underground. It's a relief that they're not recklessly destroying the world with Elona at the forefront. Our alliance would be burdensome for such an act.'
Similarly, the Enemy Tribe was also sticking to their declaration of war. They were continuing the war while absolutely excluding damage to civilians.
Jin felt a little pride in that fact.
If his alliance with Vamel didn't exist right now, the world would have turned into hell due to their war.
Woo woo woo.
Suddenly, the communication device in his office let out a heavy resonance. It was a communication request from Tikan.
{Lord Jin.}
"Speak, Your Majesty."
{Lady Ameris just said that Zephyrin seems to have woken up from unconsciousness.}

Ameris was presuming that Zephyrin was one of her heads. So she said that when she woke up, Zephyrin and Orgal both lost consciousness. In fact, the moment they lost their senses and when Ameris woke up perfectly matched.
"In that case, we must go to them to receive the rightful reward for the deal we made last time."

Kinzelo had asked Jin to protect them from the Enemy Tribe for a while. In return, Jin had agreed to receive a large amount of steel and a method from Kinzelo to bypass the Sealed Wall and bring the devil.
He was still receiving the steel, but he had not heard about the devil yet. It's because Orgal and Zephyrin, who were supposed to bring the devil to Kinzelo, were unconscious.
{Are you going right now?}
"Yes, I will return to Tikan, not to the Sword Garden."
{Understood, Lord. Please be careful.}
Kinzelo's new headquarters.
This time, too, Bubare and Ainas sat in front of the main gate, watching ants play, and sprang up when they saw the red owl appear.
"Hey, hey! Those crazy guys are invading someone else's front yard again!"
"Jin Runcandel has barged in again!"
Jin ignored them and passed by, but Murakan did not.
[Raaaah!]
He deliberately changed his face back to its original form, terrifying them.
"Eeek!"
"If you hit me, I'll tell my sister!"
[Hehe, get lost.]
Bubare and Ainas vanished into the main gate in panic. Jin and Murakan slowly followed them toward the main gate.
"We've come to receive something from your leader, so step aside."
"....Wait, we need to report this to our superiors."
Jin waited a moment for the gatekeeper beastmen. If he ignored the gatekeepers and went in, Orgal might react as extremely as he did last time.
Of course, now that Murakan was with him, Orgal wouldn't be able to do that no matter how bad his mood was.
"...Go in."
"Wow, you're brave? You dared to speak informally to Lord Murakan."
The gatekeeper trembled in fear without daring to look at Murakan.

Once inside, they again felt the hostile gazes of the demons, just as they did last time. However, there were no demons awkwardly trying to attack them like before. They just looked like beasts baring their teeth out of fear.
'How on earth do they bring these creatures here? Can I get the answer today?'
Of course, one's mind differs when entering and exiting a restroom.
Kinzelo could have dodged, saying he had paid enough for the last deal.
'But Orgal and Zephyrin wouldn't fail to realize that now is the time to cooperate with me if they have any thoughts. There's no rule that the Enemy Tribe has to keep fighting Zephyr only.'

Kinzelo was in many ways opposite to the Enemy Tribe. The beastmen couldn't resist at all, and the combat power of the demons Jin had seen so far couldn't handle the core personnel and technology of the Enemy Tribe.
"Jin Runcandel... we've never said we're ready to pay the price for the last deal. How did you know that I and my master have woken up and come looking for us like a ghost?"
"Zephyrin, it's been a long time."
"Shall I take a guess? The Great Serpent, Ameris, seems to be with you."
Jin smiled at Zephyrin who openly mentioned Ameris's name.
"So you were one of Lady Ameris's heads too?"
